_: Where a machine keeps its test history: one row per input the rule distinguishes. platform is windows, macos or linux; home is the home folder; env holds the variables set (an absent name is unset); expected is the folder as segments, the first one a root, or null for no folder. Scripts/Get-TestHistoryDir.ps1 (Resolve-P20TestHistorySegments) and agent/core/log.py (test_history_segments) each assert every row. consts.json tests.historyBase, historyFallback and historyPath hold the pieces.

rows.name: macOS: Application Support under the home folder
macOS takes no base variable, so XDG_STATE_HOME is not read there
Windows: LOCALAPPDATA when it is set
Windows: the home folder's AppData/Local when LOCALAPPDATA is unset
Windows: a blank LOCALAPPDATA is unset
Linux: XDG_STATE_HOME when it is set
Linux: an empty XDG_STATE_HOME is unset
the override wins on every platform, trimmed
under the run marker with no override: no folder, so nothing is written
under the run marker on Windows, LOCALAPPDATA set: still no folder
under the run marker with an override: the override
an empty run marker is no marker
